title: Prophets and the Christ of Jesus (chs. 1–18)
english: After six books, Book VII faces Celsus’s attack on the claim that Jewish prophets foretold the things about Christ Jesus.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Wealth hard for the rich; Jesus not anti-law (chs. 19–35)
english: Jesus the Nazarene does not legislate against Moses on wealth; it is hard for the rich to enter, yet that does not cancel the law’s voice.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.

title: Agreeing with outsiders when they speak well (chs. 36–52)
english: We practice hating no one who speaks well — even outsiders — and do not quarrel for quarrel’s sake when truth is said outside the faith.

title: Powers allotted under the greatest God — BOOK VII CLOSEOUT (chs. 53–70)
english: Celsus’s scheme of powers allotted by the greatest God over each work needs deeper science than he offers; Book VII closes on that unfinished claim.
